evals.prompt: Is there livestock data on the Climate Action Data Hub? I want cattle density around Nairobi.
evals.expected_output: Fetches llms.txt, picks glw4-2020, reads its index.md, chooses the Zarr or the cattle COG from the cogs file list, loads only a window around Nairobi, and gives the record's Cite line.

assertions.name: subsets_first
assertions.description: Reads a Nairobi window or one file, not the whole store

assertions.name: cites_record
assertions.description: Includes the record's Cite line verbatim

evals.prompt: https://cgiar-climate-data-hub.github.io/catalog/chirts-era5-daily/ - get me 2023 daily max temperature for a point at 0.5N 37.5E. I'm in a sandbox behind a proxy.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Zarr distribution (primary access) over HTTPS with storage_options client_kwargs trust_env=True, selects the 2023 time range and nearest point, and does not download the 118 GB store.

assertions.name: point_and_time_subset
assertions.description: Selects the point and 2023 before computing

evals.prompt: Can you load AgERA5 relative humidity from the Hub for Ghana?
evals.expected_output: Reads the agera5 record, notes access is restricted and needs a CDS token (or Earth Engine account), asks the user for it before loading, and offers climate-data-download as the alternative route.

assertions.name: flags_restricted
assertions.description: Says an account or token is needed before trying to load

assertions.name: no_fake_credentials
assertions.description: Does not invent or hard-code a token

evals.prompt: Using the Climate Action Data Hub, what's the topsoil (0-5 cm) clay content at -13.96, 33.79 in Malawi?
evals.expected_output: Reads the soilgrids record and applies both caveats: the record note says the maps are in Interrupted Goode Homolosine (ESRI:54052), so the lat/lon point is reprojected before sampling; the clay variable note says values are g/kg x 10 stored as int16, so the raw value is divided by 10 to give percent. Reads only the one point over HTTPS, not a global map, and gives the record's Cite line. Expected answer (checked 2026-11-16): raw 180, so about 18% clay.

assertions.name: reprojects_point
assertions.description: Transforms the lat/lon point to ESRI:54052 (Homolosine) before sampling, or samples with a CRS-aware method

assertions.name: applies_scale_factor
assertions.description: Divides the raw clay value by 10 and reports it as percent (or g/kg) with the unit stated

assertions.name: point_read_only
assertions.description: Reads a single pixel or small window, not the global map

assertions.name: cites_record
assertions.description: Includes the record's Cite line verbatim
